title: IOCs, STIX and YARA for AiTM phishing campaigns: SCGX02 / CodeStorm, Green Proxy (RFQ AiTM) and Mirai 'wraith'
description: Indicators of compromise, STIX 2.1 bundles, feeds and YARA rules published by Raiku Solutions (Chile) from incident response work: the SCGX02 / CodeStorm AiTM kit, the undocumented 'Green Proxy' Microsoft 365 AiTM phishing-as-a-service (two-step RFQ delivery) and a related Mirai C2. Write-up: https://raiku.cl/research/green-proxy . TLP:CLEAR.
